idea: 对非拥挤价值因子（价值减拥挤）进行高斯分位拉伸以强化极端尾部信号，同时用柯西分布拉伸ESG各组件间差异的非对称性（衡量E-S-G阶梯结构的不平整度），两者相乘识别极端非拥挤但ESG结构特殊的利基市场机会。
expression_list: quantile(multiply(group_zscore(rsk74_value_ts, industry), reverse(group_zscore(rsk74_crowding, industry))), "gaussian") * quantile(subtract(abs(subtract(rsk74_factor_e, rsk74_factor_s)), abs(subtract(rsk74_factor_s, rsk74_factor_g))), "cauchy")

quantile(multiply(group_zscore(rsk74_value_ts, industry), reverse(group_zscore(rsk74_crowding, industry))), "gaussian") * quantile(subtract(abs(subtract(rsk74_factor_esg, rsk74_factor_s)), abs(subtract(rsk74_factor_s, rsk74_factor_g))), "cauchy")

quantile(multiply(group_zscore(rsk74_value_ts, industry), reverse(group_zscore(rsk74_raw_crowding, industry))), "gaussian") * quantile(subtract(abs(subtract(rsk74_factor_e, rsk74_factor_s)), abs(subtract(rsk74_factor_s, rsk74_factor_g))), "cauchy")

quantile(multiply(group_zscore(rsk74_value_ts, industry), reverse(group_zscore(rsk74_raw_crowding, industry))), "gaussian") * quantile(subtract(abs(subtract(rsk74_factor_esg, rsk74_factor_s)), abs(subtract(rsk74_factor_s, rsk74_factor_g))), "cauchy")
